sourceArtNotes.crush: Forelegs leave ground while chest and shell-front rise; impact plants front feet forward-left and lowers chest. Rear toes remain180,103. No whole-body leap.
sourceArtNotes.recovery: Existing accepted recovery reused unchanged. Runtime visual acceptance should verify shell_prepare reverse exit and crush impact settle.
